Hi! I am Zana, a PhD student at Karolinska Institutet. I am more of a wet-lab scientist, trying to get into bioinformatics. But I'm also ✨*just a girl*✨ and I was always very scared of computers and data and all these things. But I thought *How hard can it be...boys do it...👀*

## My research

My PhD project is about **immune evasion in Merkel cell carcinoma**, a rare and aggressive skin cancer. I am trying to understand why some tumours do not respond to immunotherapy. 


## Why this blog?

I started this blog during the course *Reproducible Research in Bioinformatics and Computational Biology*. To be honest I have no idea what I'm doing but I will figure it out eventually. I want to use this blog to document my learning journey.
